_specs: The design name comes from the Shopify image filename, the only record of what the print is. Nothing about the artwork is invented.
buyBody: A single-flower print with a name every golfer recognizes from the second week of April. Understated on the shirt, less so in what it is referring to.
pieceHeadline: Named after the hole, not the flower
pieceParas: Anyone who watches golf in spring knows what an azalea means, and the print is deliberately quiet about it — a repeating flower, no commentary.
It sits in the softer half of the range: a pattern, but one you have to choose to notice.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, spring light and green surroundings. The reference does the work; the shot should not try to explain it. There is no on-body apparel photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
